    stripe_rows=next(r for r in range(h-2) if sum(
        1 for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] and grid[r][c]==grid[r+1][c]==grid[r+2][c])>1)
    pts=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if not stripe_rows<=r<stripe_rows+3]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
